ApiToken.description: An API token as listed (never includes the secret).

created_via.description: `web` (minted on the Tokens page) or `device` (CLI login).

AuthInfo.description: How the web app signs in.

mode.description:
`oidc` (sign in through a provider at `/auth/login`) or `dev`
(every request is a fixed local user).

AuthProvider.description: A sign-in provider the web app can offer.

Comment.description: A comment thread: the top-level comment and its replies.

oneOf.description: Absent for a general comment about the whole parcel.

version.description: The version the commenter was looking at.

CommentAnchor.description: Where on the page a comment points, as recorded by the viewer.

path.description: Published path of the page the comment was made on (`index.html`).

selector.description: CSS selector of the element that was clicked.

text.description:
The element's visible text when the comment was made, used to find
it again after the page changes.

x.description: Click position inside the element's box, as a fraction of its width (0–1).

y.description: Click position inside the element's box, as a fraction of its height (0–1).

CommentAuthor.description: Who wrote a comment, from the caller's point of view.

name.description: Display name (the account's name, else its email).

open.description: Unresolved threads on the parcel, whatever the filter.

CommentReply.description: A reply in a comment thread.

expires_in_days.description: Days until expiry; omit for a token that never expires.

CreatedToken.description: A freshly minted token. `secret` is shown exactly once.

DataCollection.description: A collection as listed in a [`DataSummary`].

usage_bytes.description: What the collection counts against the parcel's data limit.

size_bytes.description: Size of the value as compact JSON.

DataItemList.description: A page of a collection's items, ordered by key.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

revision.description: Changes whenever any item is written or deleted.

usage_bytes.description: Each item's JSON size plus a fixed per-item overhead.

writable.description: Whether the caller may change this parcel's data.

client_name.description: Shown on the approval page, e.g. `parcel CLI on laptop`.

device_code.description: Secret the CLI polls with. Never shown to the user.

user_code.description: Short code the user confirms in the browser, e.g. `BCDF-GHJK`.

ErrorBody.description:
The error envelope every non-2xx JSON response uses
(`stridelabs_http::AppError`'s wire contract).

type.description: The HTTP status reason phrase, e.g. `Bad Request`.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

Limits.description: Storage and size limits enforced on publishes.

max_data_bytes.description: Data a parcel may keep (each item's JSON plus a per-item overhead).

max_data_value_bytes.description: Largest single data value, as compact JSON.

user_quota_bytes.description: Total bytes across all of a user's versions; 0 means unlimited.

signed_in_with.description:
Label of the provider this web session signed in with (absent for
API tokens and dev mode).

NewComment.description: `POST /api/v1/parcels/{id}/comments` — a new thread, or a reply.

oneOf.description: Where on the page. Not allowed on replies.

reply_to.description: Reply to this thread instead of starting a new one.

version.description:
The version being commented on. Defaults to the current one; ignored
for replies, which take their thread's.

file.description: One part per file; each part's filename is its published path.

ParcelAccess.description: What the caller may do with a parcel.

ParcelActivity.description:
`GET /api/v1/parcels/{id}/activity` — what the viewer polls to notice
new versions and comment changes without refetching everything.

comments_revision.description: Changes whenever any comment is added, edited, resolved or deleted.

ParcelDetail.description: A parcel with its history and current files.

is_owner.description: Whether the caller owns this parcel (and so may change it).

owner_name.description: The owner's display name, for signed-in callers.

total.description: Total number of matching parcels (for pagination).

ParcelSummary.description: A parcel as it appears in lists.

entry.description: Path of the current version's entry page.

url.description: The viewer URL in the web app (`https://…/p/<id>`).

PublishResult.description: Returned by both create and new-version publishes.

file.description: One part per file; each part's filename is its published path.

allow_public.description:
Whether parcels may be made public; when false, `internal` is the
widest visibility.

Share.description: One person a parcel is shared with.

name.description: Their display name, once someone with this email has signed in.

ShareRole.description: What a person a parcel is shared with may do.

SharedParcel.description: A parcel someone shared with the caller by name.

resolved.description: Resolve or reopen a thread (the parcel's owner or the thread's author).

UpdateParcelRequest.description: `PATCH /api/v1/parcels/{id}` — metadata only; files change through versions.

Usage.description: What a user is currently storing.

stored_bytes.description: Sum of every version's `total_bytes` (what the quota counts).

VersionDetail.description: A version with its file list.

VersionSummary.description: One immutable version of a parcel.

label.description: Optional short note recorded with the publish ("Draft to legal").

content_url.description: Signed, expiring URL on the sandboxed content origin.

owner_name.description: The owner's display name, for signed-in callers.

bearer.description: A `pcl_` API token. (The web app sends its session cookie instead.)

info.description: Publish HTML pages (with optional supporting files) to private, sandboxed URLs, manage their versions, visibility and sharing, and read them back. Authenticate with a `pcl_` API token (the CLI and agents); the web app uses the session cookie its server-side sign-in (`/auth/login`) sets. Health probes, sign-in, the sandboxed content origin (`/v/{token}/…`) and the web app itself are deliberately not part of this document.

post.description: Publish a new version (the URL stays the same). In `merge` mode (default) uploaded files are added or replaced, others are kept, and `remove` drops paths; in `replace` mode the version is exactly the uploaded files. `base_version` makes the publish fail with 409 if someone else published first.

Raw bytes of one file, as an attachment. This is how the CLI and agents read a parcel's source; browsers view parcels through the sandboxed content origin instead.
